enunciado: theorem erdos_236: (fun n => (f n : ℝ)) =o[atTop] (fun n => Real.log (n : ℝ))
doc: Let $f(n)$ count the number of solutions to $n=p+2^k$ for prime $p$ and $k\geq 0$. Show that $f(n)=o(\log n)$.
contexto:
module

public import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Erdős Problem 236

*Reference:* [erdosproblems.com/236](https://www.erdosproblems.com/236)
-/

@[expose] public section

open Filter Asymptotics

namespace Erdos236

/--
$f(n)$ counts the number of solutions to $n=p+2^k$ for prime $p$ and $k\geq 0$.
-/
def f (n : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ((List.range (Nat.log2 n + 1)).filter (fun k => Nat.Prime (n - 2^k))).length
